actualite.cd: 48. The gap: link names.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.

The lesson for every team: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.

circajewels.com: 60. The gap: form labels.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 20 form controls have no label.

The lesson for every team: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
